# Test fixtures

`legacy-basic.ppt` is `basic_test_ppt_file.ppt` from the Apache POI test data (https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/trunk/test-data/slideshow), unchanged except for the file name. Apache POI. Copyright 2003-2026 The Apache Software Foundation. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. It is used by the tests only and is not shipped in the plugin.

The other files are synthetic samples made by the Zovo DOCX and PPTX viewers for VS Code. `renamed-pptx.ppt` is `quarterly-review.pptx` under another name, and `docx-as.doc` is `sample.docx` under another name.
